source: Recorded DADiskDescription samples for the mount-guard decision table.

samples.name: internal APFS
samples.provenance: Live DADiskCopyDescription on this Mac, 2026-11-07: disk0-3 are APPLE SSD AP0256Q, DADeviceInternal=true, DADeviceProtocol=Apple Fabric. No external disk attached.

samples.name: internal SATA disk
samples.provenance: diskdoctor.md section 8: the match is internal == false AND a physical protocol. No bench sample; an Intel Mac's built-in SATA disk reports DeviceInternal=true with the same protocol value an external eSATA drive would.

samples.name: internal USB media
samples.provenance: diskdoctor.md section 8: DeviceInternal must be false even when the protocol is USB; a built-in USB card reader is internal and must not be vetoed. No bench sample.

samples.name: virtual disk image
samples.provenance: Live DADiskCopyDescription on this Mac, 2026-11-07: disk4 and disk6 are 'Disk Image' with DADeviceProtocol=Virtual Interface and no DADeviceInternal key. No external disk attached.

samples.name: USB NTFS volume
samples.provenance: P0 row 5, docs/p0-runbook.md: phase-b/q5-dissent.log logged bsd=disk8s2 protocol=USB fs=iboysoft_NTFS when the Seagate control disk was replugged.

samples.name: USB whole disk
samples.provenance: P0 row 5 / phase C, docs/p0-runbook.md: the MiNaH WD3200BJKT over USB appears as a whole disk (DAMediaWhole=true) with no volume kind.

samples.name: Thunderbolt external volume
samples.provenance: diskdoctor.md section 8: external protocols are guarded when the description keys say external. No bench sample; the protocol value is the DiskArbitration string.

samples.name: unknown internal flag
samples.provenance: Plan section 8 and tools/p0/dadissent.swift: an unreadable or absent DeviceInternal field is unknown, and unknown approves; the guard must not veto what it cannot identify.
